column1: # Scenario status beyond the index's kind (coverage.py). First matching pattern wins.
# pattern: fnmatch on LABEL/ID. logic: W1 | D1 | - (W1: waits on the src/wire_*.c adapters; D1: waits on
# the BF70x drivers; -: nothing). full: emulator | hardware | OS | - (- keeps the index's kind). note: shown

column4: note
not driven: the host's hold on the disk, the USB key and the scan delay are outside s11_install() (S-10a, S-15)
not driven: no src/ logic yet formats or re-attaches the RAM disk after a scan
not driven: the menu act that flips the option (S-15); s11_install() takes the option once, when the checks begin

harness: s11_install() and s11_interrupted() on BearSSL, micro-ecc, minizip, yaffs2 and FatFs; the metadata record, the Nordic and PSoC peers and the image writers are fakes that log their calls (no SPI-flash or eMMC op log, no host link, no screen)
not driven: no src/ logic yet formats the RAM disk after a scan (wire_fat_format() writes only S-12.007's sectors; zeroing the rest is its caller's)

harness: the files written through wire_fat_mkdir() and wire_fat_write_file() with the vector's contents (src/ has no writer of systeminfo/ yet) and the log export from yaffs2; the trigger and the medium's presence are not observed
harness on a 64-block volume (the full one needs 2.25 GiB of memory): the free space reported and the reserve at the refusal; the total space is not checked
harness: wire_yaffs_format() and the mount of an all-zero volume; the factory reset and the settings file (S-15) are not driven
harness: the mount, a create and wire_yaffs_format(); the settings-file read and the factory reset (S-15) are not driven
harness: changes and listings through src/wire_yaffs.c and yaffsfs calls, not over the bridge or MTP; the RAM block device's write and erase log stands in for the eMMC model's

harness: src/wire_fat.c and src/wire_yaffs.c on RAM block devices, with gen_vectors.py --images's images, read back with conformance/fs; the USB host model, the boot and the S-15 triggers are not in the loop
BF70x core bring-up (src/drivers/bf70x)
BF70x buses and pins (src/drivers/bf70x)
display panel driver (src/drivers/bf70x)

harness: every set, speed and serial variant as s10a_desc.c builds it (h_s10a serves GET_DESCRIPTOR as s10a_usb.c's callbacks do), checked byte for byte and by conformance/usb; no bus, no SET_ADDRESS sequence, no real host

harness: s10a_ch9_setup() on every set against s10a_model's Ep0, the stack's part played by h_s10a (descriptors, the halt state); data toggles are not observed; the CDC and audio class requests (S-10a.060-.062, .070) are not driven (s10a_cdc.c and s10a_usb.c not linked)

harness: s10a_bot.c through a host model on the two bulk endpoints, halts cleared through s10a_ch9_setup(): the thirteen cases for every scsi.json command, the refused CBWs and the reset recovery, Get Max LUN; no bus timing

harness: the offers and withdrawals made directly on the unit (no S-12 writer, no scan): the TEST UNIT READY poll, a withdrawal during a READ's data phase, (c) one held back by a READ left in its data phase until a Bulk-Only Mass Storage Reset or a bus reset, INQUIRY throughout

harness: the releases the unit counts (eject, stop, PREVENT/ALLOW, bus reset, SET_CONFIGURATION 0 and the current value through s10a_ch9_setup(), a scan's withdrawal while held and an own write's); the upgrade log and S-11's scan are not in the loop
not driven: needs the USB stack (s10a_usb.c on TinyUSB), the bus or the PSoC link (attach, modes, power, CDC, bulk timing, reset, suspend)

harness: src/s10b_mtp.c at level W through h_s10b, over an in-memory volume that stands in for the bridge and yaffs2: every script of vectors/writes.json, handles bound through the device's own listing, each response, parameter and dataset, and the volume after against the model's; the yaffs2 image, its headers (S-12.059) and reserve (S-12.056), the cancel and bus-reset cuts and the power cut are the unit tests' (test_s10b_mtp, test_s09_files) or the emulator's
harness: src/s10b_mtp.c at level R through h_s10b: writes.json's readonly script, with no change operation in the volume's ops at all; the image check is the emulator's

not driven here: needs the USB host model on the MTP function (s10a_usb.c on TinyUSB) or a volume image; the vectors are replayed by the unit test test_s10b_mtp, and test_s10b.py drives the operation sweep and DeviceInfo at both levels

harness: runs 1-4, 8-12, 14-17, 19-25, 27-30 and 32-41 through h_s02 (the starts of runs 16 and 22-24 set by a flash swap; run 26's trial start, and run 30's resets, by the factory profile of images.spiflash on the flash h_s02 leaves), recovery's own protocol and writer (src/front/fr_proto.c, fr_slots.c) on the flash model, runs 4, 9, 10 and 14 with the 'none' and 'after' cuts, the hold as fr_proto_hold() against INFO's bit 5 and RESTART's answer, run 16's selector states set by flash swaps, run 17's reads failing once, the damaged state's selector programmed a byte at a time and the reach by the named slot's record; runs 5-7 (a first stage that reads the keys, the image check, the screen, the power switch, RESTART's reset), the PSoC's side of runs 10, 14 and 16 (the 0x31 {14} and when 0x32 goes), run 18, run 13 (why 3 after the start log), run 26's start of the tried slot and its log, and run 31 (the fitted first stage's own write cut) are the unit tests' (test_front_writer, test_front_proto, test_front_start) or need the front on a unit or the emulator; of runs 32-41 the starts after an action are the vectors', and RESTART's 0x44 and the damaged state's repair with no countdown the unit tests' (test_front_proto); run 42 (two slots with the same image: the running slot from the loaded memory, and every cut) is the unit tests' (test_front_same)

harness: runs 1 (the front's program and read-back), 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7 through h_s02, fr_log_start() (src/front/fr_startlog.c) on the flash model and the slot writers' last-sector erase; the hand-off record, the main image's program (run 1's second half) and run 5 (the ways in that skip the step) are the unit tests' (test_front_startlog, test_front_start) or the emulator's

harness: every row of the allowed starts under the conforming profile; torn record and selector ops (three seeds, masks 00 and FF) are checked against the profile on the state they leave, since the table assumes badtag / superset_of; the second-order cuts and the negative control are not run
harness runs the fail_op cases 1, 2 and 4; corrupt_program (3, 5) is not modeled

harness: src/s02_store.c on h_s02's flash: runs 1, 2, 4-6 and 8, run 7's flash faults (fail, stuck, late), and run 3's front part (the start-log step and recovery's survey read nothing of the sector); what a start does with the setting is test_s05.py's, and the Settings screen (runs 4, 7 and 8) is not driven
harness: the master's handling of the stage failure only; detecting a bad CRC is S-03 (test_s03.py)
harness: the master's handling of the stage failure only; detecting the encrypted flag is S-03 (test_s03.py)
harness: the master's handling of the stage failure only; the failed select is S-03 (test_s03.py)
harness: the master's handling of the stage failure only; finding no active partition is S-03 (test_s03.py)
harness: the block's contents; where the caller puts it (the handover reserve) has no caller in src/ yet

harness: s05_boot_decision on boot_decision.tsv, and boot_master (src/boot_flow.c) on start_in_menu.tsv's starts with the setting as its op answers it (the boot store's read is test_s02.py's SC-BOOTSTORE); the recovery rows are the front's

not driven here (the host's 19, or digit 6 after an OS write or a run): the restart's order is S-04's R-W11 (s04_reboot, test_s04.py) and the next start S-05's H-CONTINUE-NEXT; the screen, its hold and the board's choice of W11 or W2 are the board's (tests/unit/test_board_services.c, test_s15_menu.c) or the emulator's

harness: boot_master (src/boot_flow.c) with reason 80 and the setting on, against reason 20, and with keys held, the state 0xAB0D, an absent slave and a failed stage; the record's bytes are R-ROWS row 80
the CRC-8 is test glue in h_s06.c (src/ takes it as a function)
the 5 cases that take S-03.058's optional rewrite_erase are skipped: src/ never takes it

harness: s09_boot_slave on the three slots against a boot-link model (bridge_check stream, PA6 at each byte, seeded) and the bad_crc, no_ready, no_open, no_open_stuck and slow_block variants; the first PC11 edge and the slave-role run are not observed
harness: stream_stuck's boot-link part only (no byte after the 100th, given up within T_STREAM); the other causes, held mode and the shutdown are not run
harness: sessions 1-6 and their bytes; SPI0's configurations are not observed (configure() is a stub)
harness: bridge_check master and requests.json (the pad variant included) over a master-slave loopback; PA6/PC11 edges are not observed; push is not sent
harness: the slave's rx_len and session_len for each requests.json item; PA4/PB2 edges are not observed
harness: the init and echo replies, rx_len and session_len; SPI2's configuration and the noise variant are not run

harness: the replies.json shapes (immediate and deferred) from a store glue, and the malformed variant (malformed.json, handed to the slave directly); the S-03 and S-12 operations behind them are not in the loop

harness: two requests in flight through a test hook (the second call made from the first's PC5 read: the bootloader's calls are synchronous), a stat and a statfs rather than two file reads (the slave makes a read's next piece only when polled); a slave model shows the second's reply first; PC5 edges are not timed

harness: 20 requests of a directory listing in pairs through the same hook, the pull and two requests held, the replies collected as the calls return (newest first: the master frees a slot when its caller takes the reply); the full variant is not driven: it needs three caller requests in flight, and this master's synchronous calls hold the collected reply's slot until its caller returns

harness: three deferred requests handed to the slave directly, PB2 read after each session; the store glue answers at once, so the finish order is the arrival order; the 5 ms eMMC delay is not modeled
harness: s09_master_read() directly (no S-12 hook), against a store glue serving the case's file
harness: the slave's piece replies from a store glue serving the case's file; yaffs2 and the eMMC fault are not in the loop
harness: reply_0, reply_1 and reply_7 (values, sessions); the kernel call, held mode, the delays and reply_none are not run
harness: imm_release_ok and imm_release_noos from a scripted OS status; staging (S-05) is not in the loop

harness: the pull's bytes (pull_now, pull_later); S-06 frames pushed to a slave node, whole and in order; the 0xBD clock message; the power-off exchange and power_silent; the USB host's traffic, the 60 s run and the PSoC's 0x51 are not in the loop
harness: the real master as the scripted master, the slave handling its CPU link after each request session it is handed: ping, power_off, time_len3 and overflow
harness: the 0x0B sessions handed to the slave directly (a count, then 0); the log is not observed

harness: s09_master_link_fast() and the real slave over h_s09's bus, which records each session's rung from configure() and carries a rung corrupt, deaf or with a reply value wrong; the rungs tried and kept (link_rungs.json), the check on every request on a rung, a 0x7000-byte write once after a fall-back, the slave falling back alone, the echoes unanswered; SPI0's set-up per rung (S-13b.041) and the bus timing are not observed, and quad I/O is a flag of the bus model

harness: the slave's link logic handed sessions directly: every row of link_modes.json (a receive that fails and T_TRIAL both enter the slave as the board's fault call: the board's receive and its trial timer are not in the loop), link_test.json in the plain and the quad mode, link_requests.json served and refused; write_8000 through wire_s09 on yaffs2 (h_s11's loopback); trial_silent's timing and quad_listen's SPI2 set-up need the board

harness: src/s07_psoc.c and src/s07_program.c on the unit tests' virtual clock and fake port (h_s07p) against s07_model's PSoC answering every write; each transcript judged by s07_model.timed_check; the S-11 upgrade around the step and the device's own PSoC unlock are not part of it

no scenario driven; requirement checks of S-07's rules and of the Cypress loader's packets, probe and runs in test_s07.py (a run is fed the replies the conformance bootloader gave s07_model's host; S-07.079's short payloads are applied by the driver, as the caller would)
no scenario driven; requirement checks of S-08's reading rules in test_s08.py (the Nordic link's exchanges are not driven; the CRC-16 is test glue)

harness: src/s10c_host.c on the fw-continue-* and coproc-early-continue-psoc transcripts, frame by frame, the device's state (held mode, the slave) set by h_s10c, the board's restart (W11, or W2 without the slave) a stub; the USB device, the carrier's framing, the detach, the restart and the start that follows (S-05's H-CONTINUE) are not in the loop
no scenario driven; requirement checks of S-10c's codecs and texts in test_s10c.py (the command server s10c_host.c and the USB device are not driven)
